description: This file defines and registers chat commands for an auto-reply system, including command validation, alias registration, and built-in command definitions.

methods.name: defineChatCommand
methods.description: Creates a ChatCommandDefinition object from input parameters, handling defaults and aliases.

methods.name: registerAlias
methods.description: Adds additional text aliases to existing commands, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: assertCommandRegistry
methods.description: Validates the list of commands for duplicates, missing required fields, and correct alias formatting.

methods.name: buildBuiltinChatCommands
methods.description: Constructs and registers a set of predefined chat commands for the system.
